title: Domain Care Auto-Renew Credit on Restore Charges for Domain Registrations
content:
**Domain Registrations — Domain Care auto-renew credit, restore charges.**

The restore line's autopay credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, is USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered where the domain's auto-renew setting is on and no declined auto-renew attempt is recorded on it less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match, USD 0.20 for each year the charge covered where the setting is on and at least one such declined attempt is recorded, and nothing where auto-renew is off.

Both the setting and the decline history are read on the day of the price match.

| Condition on the day of the price match | Credit for each year the charge covered |
|---|---|
| Auto-renew on, no declined auto-renew attempt recorded on the domain in the preceding 12 whole months | USD 0.50 |
| Auto-renew on, one or more such declined attempts | USD 0.20 |
| Auto-renew off | Nothing |

**Look-back edge.** A month counts only once its day of the month is reached: a declined attempt recorded on 30 April 2028 is inside the look-back for a price match on 29 April 2029 and outside it on 30 April 2029.

**Positive and negative cases (hypothetical).**
- Auto-renew on, last decline recorded 14 months before the price match, charge covering one year: USD 0.50.
- Auto-renew on, a decline recorded 2 months before: USD 0.20.
- Auto-renew off, no declines at all: nothing.
